services.name: CrossFit DC
services.desc: We provide a robust schedule of classes with programmed CrossFit workouts six days a week. Each class provides a coach-led warm up and workout with an emphasis on technique and safety. Workouts include a near infinite combination of functional movements - Squats, Deadlifts, Clean and Jerks, Rowing, Muscle Ups, Burpees etc. Guidance from our coaches ensures the correct balance of skill work and intensity, while the camaraderie of the group helps you rise to the challenge. services.name: RebeccaYoga Teacher
services.desc: HYROX training classes are fun, challenging, conditioning wokouts and also help athletes effectively prepare for the HYROX race, which involves running interspersed with various functional movements. HYROX classes focus on building cardio and strength capacity as well as training under fatigue to mimic the race’s demands and include an intentional mix of exercises and equipment such as burpees, push-ups, dumbbells, kettlebells, rowers, bikes and sled push/pulls. Athletes of all fitness and strength levels are welcome as the weights used are scalable and movements will be familiar to all. services.name: Classes & Programming
services.desc: This plan is designed to prepare you to move safely and efficiently in our CrossFit classes over the course of 4 Elements sessions. You'll also have access to HYROX, Yoga and our monthly Bring a Friend Workouts until you unlock the full schedule. Elements: The main purpose of The Welcome Plan is to take your through our Elements course. Our small group Elements classes focus on teaching the fundamental movements needed to join our CrossFit classes. Each session will focus on a few of the exercises that are foundational to CrossFit.
